title: Idle planning observers share canonical data without polling
description: On one isolated gateway and actual mounted browser panel, attach two read-only canonical cache observers and count real outgoing planning read frames for 16 seconds. No source writes, cache/UI injection or native work.

proofTargets.claim: Two additional real cache observers share the mounted backlog query and remain attached for the entire measured window.
A continuously mounted online planning view produces zero periodic planning reads across a16second interval on the same document, connection and principal.
Normal sign-out closes the owned tab, removes the disposable item and preserves original planning facts.

prove.intent: Prove planning observers through the actual isolated browser and owning gateway.

multipleCanonicalObservers.intent: Verify both additional observers remain attached throughout the window.

noPeriodicPlanningReads.intent: Verify zero planning reads during the online idle window.

ownedFixtureRemoved.intent: Verify sign-out, tab closure and owned fixture removal.
